description: Three disjoint foundations: the nvidia model chain plus Env fallback list (cu-001), stdin isolation in both child-process adapters plus the launcher and the StdinIsolationSpec (cu-002), and a ReadinessGate that honours maxWait against the wall clock (cu-003)
Chain integration: model-per-call EnrichmentPort, list-based readiness probe, model rotation inside maxAttempts, AppContainer wiring, and the affected specs (cu-004)
Live end-to-end verification on this host: one enrichment poll with the nvidia chain, a committed non-zero offset, no timeout, and a restored .env (cu-005)
